reuse.why: Builds the recurrence with the shared recurConfigToRSchedule and RSchedule and moves weekend days with the shared applyWeekendRule, as getUpcomingDates does, though it re-states the daily-skip rule locally.

duplication.why: The occurrence pipeline (RSchedule from recurConfigToRSchedule, map through applyWeekendRule, dayFromDate, captureBreadcrumb catch) is a near-copy of getUpcomingDates, and the moveWeekend = frequency !== 'daily' branch repeats knowledge recurConfigToRSchedule already encodes.

placement.why: A handler in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates is where the tree puts these; the range-enumeration core could have been a shared helper in shared/schedules but this is acceptable.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and readable with the shared weekend rule, but the daily special case and the parallel copy of the getUpcomingDates pipeline are two places to keep in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: weekend adjustment and recurrence building go through applyWeekendRule and recurConfigToRSchedule

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes the getUpcomingDates occurrence->applyWeekendRule->dayFromDate pipeline into a loop with a Set instead of extracting it; the daily-skip rule is restated as moveWeekend
